prompts.name: 01-explore
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: individual high-fidelity mobile app screen design proposal for Lumio.
Input image: approved Lumio C—Editorial logo, reference for brand identity only. Preserve the wide ticket with inward side notches and upper-right triangular cutout, and substantial title-case serif Lumio wordmark.
Style: exceptionally polished editorial cinema journal meets native Android app. Flat digital screen, portrait 9:19.5 proportions, no phone hardware, no perspective, no presentation board. Full screen edge to edge. Proposed warm ivory background, near-black type, restrained muted coral accent. Substantial editorial serif headings, crisp readable sans serif controls, generous whitespace, fine rules, restrained squared corners, consistent thin line icons. This palette and icons are proposals.
Persistent common shell: Android status bar at top; compact Lumio lockup at upper left and settings gear at upper right. Main destinations have bottom navigation with precisely four labeled items: Explore, Swipe, Genie, Arcade. Selected destination uses coral icon and dark label; others subdued. Legible text and touch targets.
Constraints: English UI. All film titles and poster designs must be clearly fictional placeholders; use procedural geometric print-like poster art, no real movie posters, celebrities, artwork URLs, or numerical movie ratings. Do not invent cast, director, year or runtime facts. Tiny footer "Design concept • Fictional films". No extraneous decorative text, no watermark. Strong consistent hierarchy.
Screen: Explore, selected Explore tab. Heading "Find your next film." Search field "Search titles or directors" with search icon. Horizontal genre chips "All", "Drama", "Thriller", "Comedy", All selected. Section label "IN THE SPOTLIGHT". Large beautiful abstract geometric poster in ink, ivory and coral with title "The Last Light" and caption "A fictional film". Small arrow to open details. Below a ruled heading "Explore the catalog" and compact sort control "Title ↑". Two-column poster grid with abstract posters titled "Paper Moonlight" and "Quiet Cities", visible in lower portion. Keep bottom navigation clear.
